column2: Bank account master data. Includes operating accounts, payroll accounts, and investment accounts. Validate with: python workday_financial_validator.py bank_accounts this_file.csv 3

column14: Primary operating account for USD disbursements

column2: Account_Type valid values: Checking | Savings | Money_Market | Investment | Payroll
Currency: 3-letter ISO code. Each account holds one currency.
Routing_Number: 9-digit US ABA routing number for ACH. Required for US accounts using ACH. Leave blank for international accounts
IBAN: International Bank Account Number — required for EU/UK accounts. Format varies by country (e.g., GB29NWBK60161331926819)
SWIFT_Code: Required for international wire transfers. 8-11 characters (e.g., CHASUS33)
Bank_Account_Number: The actual account number. Do NOT include routing number in this field
SECURITY: This file contains sensitive banking data. Restrict access to conversion team leads only. Do not email unencrypted.
Reconciliation: After load, confirm each bank account appears in Workday Banking with correct details and currency
